title: Motorway and ‘A’ road traffic above pre-Covid levels
text:
Motorway and ‘A’ road traffic above pre-Covid levels 

# Motorway and ‘A’ road traffic above pre-Covid levels

Deniz Huseyin

15 October 2026

New traffic data from the DfT reveals that motorway traffic increased by 2.4% in 2025 compared with 2024, rising to 71.9 billion vehicle miles. Motorway traffic estimates for 2025 are above those for before the pandemic (+2.0% when compared with 2019).

There was also a rise in ‘A’ road traffic, up 1.9% from 2024, to 151.6 billion vehicle miles. ‘A’ road traffic estimates for 2025 are higher than those for before the pandemic (+0.9% when compared with 2019).
